ahead: The composite-squarefree extension (CT1)/(CT2) matches (CC1)/(CC2)'s ceiling exactly for every squarefree q tested and, by direct check up to q<=200, for every squarefree q except q in {2,6}. What is NOT done: confirming RANK3_POLYRANGE_TINT_CHECK.md's partial-summation argument over 2<=q<=R0 still gives O_eps(N^{2+eps}) once the weight is mu(q)^2 q/phi(q)^2 (composite q) rather than mu(q)^2/phi(q) (the weight that argument was checked against for primes) -- the two differ by a log-log(q) factor via Mertens' third theorem (phi(q) >> q/loglog(q)), which is very likely absorbed by that argument's N^epsilon but was not verified here. That check, applied to the full range including composite q, is the one remaining piece needed to overturn RANK3_CROSS_TERM_CANCELLATION.md section 5's conclusion that the full q-sum's order is unchanged at O(N^{5/2}).

work.what: In hunts/prime_pair_error/RANK3_POLYRANGE_TINT_CHECK.md section 3, a partial-summation argument (against classical Barban-Davenport-Halberstam) shows that a weight w(q) = O(1/phi(q)) on sum_b^*T(q,b), summed over 2<=q<=R0 with R0 = Q/log(N), Q = floor(sqrt(N)/3), gives O_eps(N^{2+eps}); RANK3_CROSS_TERM_CANCELLATION.md section 5 already checked this goes through unchanged for w(q)=O(1/phi(q)) (not just O(1/phi(q)^2)) for PRIME q, where the actual weight reached is mu(q)^2 q/phi(q)^2 ~ 1/phi(q). hunts/prime_pair_error/RANK3_COMPOSITE_CROSS_TERM.md (new document, this attempt) extends the underlying cross-term identity to composite squarefree q and shows the SAME ceiling q*sum_b^*T(q,b) holds there too (exact identity CT1, bound CT2, both verified to floating-point precision at q in {6,10,14,15,21}, N up to 10^6), with the caveat that the resulting weight mu(q)^2 q/phi(q)^2 equals O(log-log(q)/phi(q)) for composite q by Mertens' third theorem (phi(q) >> q/loglog(q)), an extra log-log(q) factor worse than the prime case's O(1/phi(q)). The task: redo RANK3_POLYRANGE_TINT_CHECK.md section 3's partial-summation computation (or the equivalent argument in RANK3_CROSS_TERM_CANCELLATION.md section 5) with this exact weight mu(q)^2 q/phi(q)^2 summed over ALL squarefree q in 2<=q<=R0 (not just primes), and determine whether the extra log-log(q) factor is absorbed into the O_eps(N^{2+eps}) bound's epsilon, or genuinely changes the achieved order. If it is absorbed, this closes the gap RANK3_CROSS_TERM_CANCELLATION.md section 5 left open ('the full 2<=q<=R0 sum's order is unchanged by this document... unless composite squarefree q are separately handled') and the rank-3 q-sum over ALL squarefree q reaches O_eps(N^{2+eps}) rather than the CHHL-matching O(N^{5/2}). If not, state precisely what order is reached instead and why the log-log(q) factor does not absorb. Also verify directly (not just via the Mertens asymptotic) that phi(q)^2 >= q for every squarefree q >= 7 (checked by this attempt only up to q=200, where q in {2,6} are the sole exceptions among squarefree q) -- if this is a known elementary fact or provable in a few lines, state the proof; if a counterexample exists at larger q, that changes which composite q need the min(phi(q)^2, q) fallback in RANK3_COMPOSITE_CROSS_TERM.md section 5. Write results only under hunts/prime_pair_error/; do not touch zeta/, ontology/, harness/, docs/, or tests/; the word with letters c-e-r-t-i-f-i-e-d is banned anywhere under hunts/, including inside a sentence disclaiming it.
